reason: We do storytime, the park and church group for free, so paying $13 a visit for something I can get for nothing is hard to justify on $48k. I'd maybe take the free first visit, but I wouldn't start paying.
objection: Will bigger kids be running wild around my baby? The gated Baby Nook helps, but I'd have to see it in person, and even then it's a recurring cost for something I already get free.
would_change_my_mind: A free or very cheap (under $5) under-2 session at set quiet hours, with real proof that the Baby Nook stays separate from the 5-year-olds.
